name: OJBench
intro: OJBench是一个新颖且具有挑战性的基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型在竞争级代码推理方面的能力。它包含232个来自NOI和ICPC的编程竞赛问题，为模型提供了更严格的推理技能测试。研究表明，即使是最先进的推理导向模型，也难以应对这些高挑战性的问题。这突显了模型在竞争级代码推理方面面临的重大挑战。
org: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tsinghua University
build_method: 赛事题目采集, 完整测试验证, 特殊评测过滤, 英译人工校验, 分来源难度标注
build_method_en: Contest Problem Collection, Full-Test Validation, Special-Judge Filtering, Verified English Translation, Source-Specific Difficulty Labeling
intro_en: OJBench is a novel and challenging benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' abilities in competitive-level code reasoning. It includes 232 programming contest problems from NOI and ICPC, providing a more rigorous test of models' reasoning skills. Studies show that even state-of-the-art reasoning-oriented models struggle with these highly challenging problems, highlighting significant challenges in competitive-level code reasoning.
scale_en: 232 problems (159 NOI + 73 ICPC; 36 easy / 79 medium / 117 hard)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.16395v2. OJBench contains 232 problems: 159 NOI tasks sourced from Luogu and 73 ICPC tasks from the official ICPC website, each with organizer test cases. Correct contestant submissions validate the tests; incomplete or erroneous test sets and tasks with unavailable special judges are removed. GPT-4o translates NOI statements to English with manual semantic and formatting checks. NOI solver votes and ICPC acceptance-attempt statistics use separate difficulty rules, producing 36 easy, 79 medium, and 117 hard problems. Evaluation samples eight candidates in Python and C++, runs the entire official test suite, requires every case to pass, and reports Pass@1 and Pass@8 by language and difficulty.
